items.title: Aflac Just Extended Its Dividend Growth Streak to 44 Years. Is It a Buy?
items.summary: Aflac posted a quarter that missed estimates for the fourth time in a row, yet the dividend sailed on untouched. Behind the ugly headline sits a payout cushion and one overseas risk that income investors cannot ignore.

items.title: RDN Q3 Earnings Beat on Specialty Strength, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: Radian's Q3 operating income rises 25.2% as Inigo bolstered Specialty Insurance, while stronger underwriting and investment income support results.

items.summary: A life insurer's Japan problem just got a longer life of its own.

items.title: Prudential Financial (PRU) Prepares To Resume Japan Business
items.summary: Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) is moving ahead with a phased re entry into Japan after a prior sales suspension. The insurer is putting enhanced governance measures in place as it prepares to restart Japanese operations. Management has completed sales of businesses in Brazil, Mexico, South Africa, Indonesia, and Kenya to narrow its international footprint. items.title: Nucor and Prudential Financial have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
items.summary: Nucor's record shipments, rising steel prices and expanding margins fuel its rally, while Prudential faces mounting Japan-related challenges and falling estimates.

items.title: At 70 He’ll Get a Letter Saying His Company Is Handing His Pension to an Insurance Company. The Check Stays the Same, but the Federal Safety Net Behind It Doesn’t
items.summary: When a letter arrives saying the company pension is moving to an insurance company, most retirees breathe easy because the check amount stays the same. What the letter leaves out is the part that actually changed.

items.title: PRU Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on PGIM and U.S. Protection Strength
items.summary: Prudential's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates by 13.9%, driven by PGIM and U.S. protection strength, despite revenue declines and Japan business headwinds.

items.title: AIZ Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Lifestyle and Housing Strength
items.summary: Assurant beats Q3 earnings estimates by 34.6% as Lifestyle and Housing gains lift results, prompting a stronger 2026 earnings outlook.
